description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the RecognizeImageColor operation
description_zh: 本文档介绍颜色识别RecognizeImageColor的语法及示例
name: RecognizeImageColor

parameters.description_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).
parameters.description_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见[文件URL处理](~~155645~~)。
parameters.help_en: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 图像URL地址。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: url

parameters.description_en: The expected number of colors in the output palette. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 3.
parameters.description_zh: 期望的色板输出数量。取值范围1~10，默认值为3。
